pages.ld_description:
Moulin Roty Tout Autour Du Monde is a  collection of soft toys from ‘All round the World’.  Animals from under the sea (Sous la Mer) and in the air (Dans la Airs) take us on a fabulous adventure with fur, feathers tentacles and scales.

There is no shortage of long limbs for this large octopus to hug you with.  He has blue eyes, a soft gold furry body and 8 long curled tentacles.  The tentacles are different lengths and are lined with different fabrics including velvet and cord.  Also available in a smaller size.

Approx 69 cm

Material: cotton, polyester,  fibres
Care: Washable at 30 ° C delicate wash. Not suitable for the drier.

Suitable from 10 months
